cards.name: Serene Mermaid of the Grand Blue

effects.printed_clause: If you control a Grand Blue monster or Umi: Special Summon this card from hand.
effects.lua_implementation: Hand ignition checks face-up Grand Blue monster or exact/treated Umi field card, open zone and summon legality.

official_references.matched_structure: Kashtira Fenrir supplies official conditional self-Special-Summon from hand structure.

effects.printed_clause: During Main Phase: Fusion Summon a Grand Blue Fusion using hand/field monsters.
effects.lua_implementation: Main Phase ignition builds set-monster hand/field material and currently supports the two printed Grand Blue Fusions, sends selected material and completes Fusion procedure.

official_references.matched_structure: Polymerization is the official hand/field Fusion material procedure.

effects.printed_clause: After the Fusion Summon, for the rest of the turn you may only Special Summon from Extra Deck using Grand Blue monsters as materials.
effects.lua_implementation: Four material prohibitions prevent non-Grand-Blue cards from being used as Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Material for the rest of the turn, but materialless Extra Deck procedures are not represented by those hooks.

official_references.matched_structure: Dogmatika Ecclesia, the Virtuous uses a post-resolution Extra Deck Special Summon restriction.

effects.issue: Confirmed as an engine/procedure gap: the generic Special Summon restriction callback does not expose a prospective material group. Official Heraldic Beast Gryphon uses additional Xyz-only workaround state and is itself marked not fully implemented; there is no general equivalent covering all Extra Deck summon procedures.

effects.printed_clause: Each effect is once per turn.

official_references.matched_structure: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring supplies named HOPT structure.

cards.audit_note: Confirmed an unresolved generic materialless Extra Deck summon gap.

coverage_override.reason: The audit records split this card into its material/procedure, restrictions, activated or continuous operations, and printed count-limit clauses; no printed functional clause is omitted.
